title: Splat2Mesh converts 3DGS PLY to OBJ/GLB for Blender and print
summary: Japanese post covering ArcanaMfg's Splat2Mesh release, which turns compatible Gaussian splat PLY files into polygon meshes exported as OBJ or GLB on Windows 11 locally without GPU. Notes watertight print-ready meshes are not guaranteed and commercial use needs a separate license.
question_it_answers: How can I convert a 3D Gaussian splat PLY into editable mesh OBJ/GLB for Blender or 3D printing?

claims.text: Splat2Mesh generates polygon meshes from compatible PLY and exports OBJ/GLB.
claims.evidence: 対応PLYからポリゴンMeshを生成し、OBJ／GLBへ出力
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting
